plan: [ It's a sealed-bid, second-price auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = value) is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies and avoids the risk of negative profit from overbidding (paying a second price above my value). Underbidding risks losing when I would have profitably won. With no prior rounds to learn from and uniform values, I will bid my exact value to maximize expected profit. ]

[ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. The weakly dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Overbidding can force a win at a price above my value (negative profit); underbidding can lose when I would have profited (price below value). With two rivals and values i.i.d. 0–49, truthful bidding maximizes expected profit regardless of their strategies. No useful history exists (only 1 round), so no adjustment is possible. I will bid exactly my value: 37. ]

[ Single round, no history to exploit. This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. The weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value: bidding higher can make you win at a price above value; bidding lower can forgo positive-profit wins. Therefore, bid exactly my value, 11, to maximize expected profit. ]
